headlines.title: Seagate (STX) Q1 Earnings Ride Record Cash Flow And AI Demand
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology came into this earnings print with its share price roughly flat over the past week and down over the last one and three months. Expectations were high after a strong run in earnings over the past year. Instead of a euphoric spike, the stock only edged up about 0.4% after the Q1 2027 release. The muted move masks what just happened. Revenue reached US$4.2b and non GAAP earnings per share landed at US$7.68, alongside record free cash flow of about US$1.5b.

headlines.title: Seagate vs. Western Digital: Which AI Storage Stock Wins?
headlines.summary: AI is minting money for hard disk drive makers, but Seagate and Western Digital are betting on rival technologies to sustain it. The wrong bet could leave one of them behind just as the cycle turns.

headlines.title: Western Digital vs. Seagate: Best AI Stock to Buy After Earnings
headlines.summary: Western Digital and Seagate benefit from surging AI storage demand, but Seagate edges ahead with higher ROE, a lower forward P/E, and record free cash flow.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
